create_TimeOrderedBuffer: create a TimeOrderedBuffer with a max timespan to hold timestamped history data
add_timestamped_data: add timestamped data values to the TimeOrderedBuffer for later retrieval and interpolation
get_delayed_value: get a delayed value from the buffer by specifying a latency offset from the latest timestamp
reset_buffer: reset and clear all stored data from the TimeOrderedBuffer deque
review_BufferTuple: review the BufferTuple dataclass that holds two values and a blending coefficient for interpolation
